recovery_policy: Preserve recovered Git history, dirty/untracked files and unique artifacts before reconciliation.
Resolve old repository names by preserved ID and source revision; route individual sections. Renaming training does not route post-training to pretraining, nor inference measurements to serving.
Original sources remain in the frozen Lab commit. Exact intermediate archives retain their own hashes; active adapted files may evolve.
Use second-stage maps for tokenizer, pre/post-training, serving/benchmark and economics relocations.
Dataset/document/split/shard manifests belong to model-data; teacher/task/response/verifier/preference types belong to model-distillation.
Research-controller owns original section 14 bounded sequencing; open-evals owns evaluation. ML foundations and RL environments are user-intended future products, not extracted LLM engines.
Unknown recovered paths require inspection; unpublished laptop work cannot be classified automatically.
verification_limits: Local inventories, exact snapshots, archive preservation and destination existence only. IDs are declared rename evidence, not live network proof. Planned homes do not imply engines; recovered laptop data has not been inspected.
